crossRefs.note: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben…

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
translations.bsb: And the border of the Reubenites was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the clans of the Reubenites, including the cities and villages.
translations.kjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages
translations.asv: And the border of the children of Reuben was the Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
